criterion: User cannot complete primary goal (PHARMACIST walk-in sale)
description: For PHARMACIST, Billing's drug search calls GET /drugs?search=… and gets 403 (wildcard RBAC). The results area stays empty and shows no message. The Treatment Packages tab reads 'No packages available' because the initial-load Promise.all failed, and the doctor select is empty. No item can be added, so the pharmacist cannot sell anything over the counter.
expected: The pharmacist can search drugs and packages. If access is denied, the screen says so.
actual: A silent empty search and an empty package list.
suggested_fix: Fix wildcard permission matching. Show an inline error on search failure, and load the four lists with allSettled.

criterion: Error surfaces only at final step; search offers unsellable items
description: OTC search lists drug-master records whether or not they have stock. Melaglow-T (no batches) shows 'Best Match ₹289.00 + Add' with no stock indicator. The user builds the whole bill, applies a package discount and previews, and only then does Confirm return 400: 'Insufficient non-expired stock for Melaglow-T Cream 15g. Required 7, available 0.' Because of D-1 no other drug can be in the master, so no walk-in sale can succeed.
expected: The search shows available stock and disables or flags zero-stock items before they are added, or it searches stocked inventory.
actual: The failure appears only at checkout, after all data entry.
suggested_fix: Join available stock into the /drugs search response (or search inventory items), show 'Out of stock' on the result card, and validate when the item is added.

criterion: Correct tax: manual adds ignore drug GST
description: Mapped #4 confirmed. A manually added drug and a package both default to Tax % = 18, whatever the drug master or inventory rate. Prescription lines in STORY-603 correctly used 12% from inventory. Unless the pharmacist retypes the rate, most medicines (5%/12%) are over-taxed.
expected: Tax % comes from the drug or inventory GST rate, and packages use their item rates.
suggested_fix: Use getDrugGstRate(drug) in addDrugToInvoice and compute the package tax from its items.

criterion: Package creator: private by default, dialog stays open
description: D-4 and D-6 confirmed during setup. The package created from Desk → Create Package is saved with isPublic=false (there is no toggle), so other staff such as the pharmacist cannot see it. After the create succeeds, the dialog stays open with all fields still filled, which makes a duplicate submit likely.
expected: A Public/Private toggle, and the dialog closes with a toast on success.
actual: Always private, and the dialog does not close.

description: In the full-screen preview, the error toast is drawn over the top of the Invoice Controls panel and hides the 'Confirm Invoice' button for several seconds.
expected: Show the error inside the Controls panel, or place the toast where it does not cover controls.
actual: The primary action is hidden while the user reads the error.

criterion: Scroll necessity: primary task below the fold
description: On sidebar 'Pharmacy Billing' the prescription dispensing queue (every pending prescription, each row about 250px tall at 1280) comes before 'New Pharmacy Invoice with Packages'. A walk-in sale always starts with scrolling past it. The page title is also duplicated.
expected: The builder comes first for a walk-in, or the queue is collapsible or placed in a side panel.
actual: About 1.5 screens of scrolling before reaching the patient field.

description: The package card reads '1 items', and Counter queue cards read '1 medicines'.
